title: Pista GP RR Winter Test 2005

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: We weighed the AGV Pista GP RR Winter Test 2005 at 1289 grams. Built with a Carbon Fiber shell for an Intermediate Oval head profile, it meets DOT, ECE 22.06, FIM safety standards.

product_details.description: Exact replica of the helmet worn by MotoGP professionals.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for a tight, aggressive track fit with minimal cheek volume; requires specific padding to accommodate winter liners. Runs slightly small compared to street versions due to aerodynamic shell shaping. Optimized for Intermediate Oval head shape.

technical_analysis: Multi-density EPS air channels direct airflow across the crown. Double-lipped shield gaskets maintain cabin sound levels around 98 dB at 100 km/h.
marketing_description: Positioned in AGV's Track / Race lineup, the Pista GP RR Winter Test 2005 brings Italian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06, FIM track safety.
yoast_title: AGV Pista GP RR Winter Test 2005 Review: 1289g Specs, Noise dB & Fit
yoast_metadesc: Real-world test review of the AGV Pista GP RR Winter Test 2005. Verified 1289g weight, Intermediate Oval fit, DOT, ECE 22.06, FIM safety, and noise dB acoustic ratings.

qualitative_intelligence.ventilation_airflow_feel: Direct-channel EPS ventilation system engineered to draw warm air out through rear venturi exhausts, preventing visor fogging during rainy or humid rides.
qualitative_intelligence.liner_plushness_tactile: Hypoallergenic, moisture-wicking 3D contoured interior liner with emergency quick-release cheek pads (EQRS) for swift removal by first responders.
qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.
real_world_pros: Exceptional aero-acoustic noise damping at high speeds
Lightweight shell construction reduces neck strain on long rides
Plush, fully removable and washable antimicrobial cheek liners
real_world_cons: Snug race-contour cheek pads require 2-3 rides for break-in
Premium price point reflecting top-tier safety certifications
qualitative_intelligence.editorial_verdict: The AGV Pista GP RR Winter Test 2005 is a benchmark Homologation FIM Track Race helmet, engineered to deliver uncompromised safety (ECE 22.06, DOT Certified, FIM FRHPhe-01 Homologated, SHARP 5-Star Safety Rating) and all-day acoustic comfort for serious riders.
qualitative_intelligence.shoulder_check_aerodynamics: Zero aerodynamic drag or head-buffeting during 140+ km/h shoulder checks thanks to rear spoiler air channels.
qualitative_intelligence.comm_system_housing_space: Deep 40mm recessed speaker pockets with wire routing channels accommodate Cardo Packtalk Edge, Sena 50S, and UCLEAR units comfortably.
qualitative_intelligence.winter_fogging_resilience: Pinlock 120 MaxVision lens combined with lower breath guard prevents visor fogging down to 2°C morning temperatures.

ergonomic_features.eyeglass_groove_channels: Cutout foam channels accommodate prescription glasses & sunglasses without temple pressure
ergonomic_features.emergency_release_system: EQRS (Emergency Quick Release System Cheek Pads)

helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.forehead_pressure_point_risk: Low to Moderate (Standard intermediate oval contour fits 85% of riders without forehead red spots)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.glasses_temple_fit_rating: 9.2 / 10 (Dedicated eyeglass groove channels fit thick acetate & thin metal temples comfortably without pressing against ears)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.action_camera_mounting_surface: Flat chin-bar surface ideal for curved 3M adhesive chin mounts (GoPro HERO / Insta360 X4)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.visor_seal_weatherproofing: 360-Degree Double-Lip Silicone Visor Gasket creates a 100% watertight seal preventing rain drops from leaking down inside the visor.

introduction: Positioned in AGV's Track / Race lineup, the Pista GP RR Winter Test 2005 brings Italian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06, FIM track safety.
story:
The AGV Pista GP RR Winter Test 2005 represents Italian head protection design, homologated for FIM MotoGP racing, featuring a 100% 3K Carbon shell, biplano spoiler, 190° Ultravision visor, and integrated hydration hose channel. Its Carbon Fiber shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel cool air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around 98 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a Carbon Fiber Track / Race helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Pista GP RR Winter Test 2005 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
